people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

translations.web: Therefore you and all your company have gathered together against Yahweh! What is Aaron that you complain against him?”
translations.bsb: Therefore, it is you and all your followers who have conspired against the LORD! As for Aaron, who is he that you should grumble against him?”
translations.kjv: For which cause both thou and all thy company are gathered together against the LORD: and what is Aaron, that ye murmur
translations.asv: Therefore thou and all thy company are gathered together against Jehovah: and Aaron, what is he that ye murmur against him?
